How It Works

Real drawing skills, built step by step

Draw it step by step

Every subject breaks down into a few guided steps with a prompt for each one. Follow the guide, trace confident lines, then submit and see your result.

  • ✓One clear prompt per step — never guess what comes next
  • ✓Adjustable guide strength while you learn
  • ✓A score and celebration for every finished attempt

Turn inspiration into a drawing

In Free Draw, bring in a photo you love, set its opacity, pinch to zoom, and sketch right over it — then make the idea your own with a full color palette and canvas colors.

  • ✓Reference photo opacity slider and pinch to zoom
  • ✓Full color picker, brush sizes, eraser, undo & redo
  • ✓No rules — just a blank canvas and your imagination

See your progress grow

Keep your creative momentum visible, one lesson at a time. The Progress tab tracks the wins that keep young artists coming back day after day.

  • ✓Daily streaks and personal bests
  • ✓XP, lessons done, and a last-7-days chart
  • ✓Progress by course, plus all your certificates

Privacy & Safety

Made for kids. Easy for parents.

Addie’s ArtWork was built to be a calm, safe creative space. Here is exactly how it behaves — no fine print.

👤

No account, no sign-in

No account or sign-in is required. Open the app and start drawing — nothing to register, nothing to log into.

📴

Works fully offline

Everything works offline. Lessons, drawings, courses, and certificates are all on the device, ready anywhere.

🛡️

No ads, no tracking, no purchases

The app contains no ads, no tracking, and no in-app purchases. Nothing to tap by accident, nothing watching along.

🔔

Reminders only if you ask

The optional daily practice reminder asks for notification permission only when you turn it on in Settings. Off by default, always your choice.

Support

Quick Fix Q&A

Start here first. Most problems fix in under a minute with the walkthroughs below. Tap a question to open the step by step fix.

↻ The app will not open, or it freezes on the welcome screen ⌄

Try these in order:

  1. Close the app fully: swipe up from the bottom (or double tap Home), swipe Addie’s ArtWork off the screen, then reopen it.
  2. Restart your iPhone or iPad and open the app again.
  3. Check for an update: open the App Store, tap your profile photo, and update Addie’s ArtWork if it is listed.
  4. Check storage: go to iPhone or iPad Settings, then General, then Storage. If the device is almost full, free up space and try again.

Please do not delete the app first, because drawings and progress saved on that device can be removed with it.

✎ I made a mistake. How do I erase, undo, or redo? ⌄

You have two eraser styles in 2.0:

  1. Open any drawing or lesson and tap the eraser tool.
  2. To rub out just part of a line, use Precise mode and rub over that part only.
  3. To remove a whole line, switch the eraser to whole line mode and tap that line.
  4. Changed your mind? Tap Undo to step back, or Redo to bring it back. Undo and redo work on every canvas, including lessons in Courses.
  5. Want a bigger or smaller eraser? Open Settings from the gear icon on Home and adjust Eraser size.
🏆 My certificate will not print or save ⌄
  1. Finish the drawing or course first, then tap the certificate when it appears.
  2. Or find it later: open the Progress tab, then tap My Certificates.
  3. Tap Print to print it, or tap Share / Save PDF to save it as a PDF.
  4. If nothing prints, check that your printer is on, on the same Wi-Fi as your device, and selected in the print sheet.
  5. Check the name on it: open Settings from the gear on Home and make sure the artist name is spelled the way you want it printed.
🦃 I cannot find the Thanksgiving or Christmas drawings ⌄

Those drawings are limited edition holiday event drawings, so they only show during their event:

  1. Thanksgiving: November 1 to 30. Look in the Draw tab under Thanksgiving Special for Turkey, Pumpkin Pie, Pilgrim Hat, and Acorn.
  2. Christmas: November 27 to January 1. Look in the Draw tab for Snowman, Gingerbread Man, Stocking, Present, and Reindeer.
  3. Outside those dates they will not appear. They come back next year.
  4. Still in season but not showing? Update to version 2.0 in the App Store, close the app fully, and reopen it. Also check your device date in Settings, then General, then Date & Time.
★ My progress, streak, or XP looks wrong ⌄
  1. Make sure you finished and submitted the drawing or lesson. Progress counts after you submit, not while you are still drawing.
  2. Open the Progress tab to see your current streak, personal best, lessons done, and total XP in one place.
  3. Check you are on the same device. Addie’s ArtWork needs no account or sign-in, so progress lives on the device where it was earned and does not move on its own.
  4. Close the app fully and reopen it, then check Progress again.
✏️ Apple Pencil is not drawing, or my finger draws when I do not want it to ⌄
  1. Open Settings from the gear icon on the Home tab.
  2. If only the Pencil should draw, turn Apple Pencil only on. With it on, fingers pan and zoom instead of drawing.
  3. If your finger should draw, turn Apple Pencil only off.
  4. If the Pencil still does not respond, check that it is charged and paired in your device Settings under Bluetooth, then close and reopen the app.
  5. Lines too thick, thin, or guides too faint? In the same Settings screen, adjust Pen size, Guide strength, and Show guide by default.
🔔 The daily practice reminder is not coming through ⌄
  1. Open Settings from the gear icon on Home and turn the daily practice reminder on.
  2. When asked, allow notifications for Addie’s ArtWork.
  3. If you tapped Don’t Allow before, fix it in your device Settings, then Notifications, then Addie’s ArtWork, and turn Allow Notifications on.
  4. Reminders are off by default and only run if you turn them on.
? Where are Settings and certificates? Quick locations ⌄
  1. Settings: tap the gear icon on the Home tab. Artist name, pen and eraser sizes, guide strength, theme, haptics, and reminders are all there.
  2. Certificates: Progress tab, then My Certificates, or right after you finish a drawing or course.
  3. Courses: open the Courses tab for Fundamentals, Shapes, Lines & Curves, Shading, and Sketching.
  4. Internet: you do not need it. Everything works offline and no sign-in is required.

Still need help? Contact me

If the quick fixes above did not solve it, email me and tell me what device you are using, what screen you were on, and what happened. Screenshots help if you have them.
